name: Roger Labric
features: fair skin, greying hair combed back, light eyes, long face, neat moustache, medium spare build, thoughtful literary expression
bio: Cyclist, aviation writer and Bugatti driver, and a friend of le Patron himself. He rode the 1920 Tour de France without finishing it, and it was Labric who entered the Type 57G Tanks at Le Mans in 1937, the year Wimille and Benoist won. He later wrote the standard history of the 24 Hours, several books on the air war of 1914-18, and the biography of his friend Robert Benoist.
